en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a line of uniformed soldiers standing at attention on an open parade ground in front of several simple wooden barracks‑style buildings with pitched roofs. Trees line the background. On the far right margin there is a vertical strip of printed text, apparently in a serif typeface. At the bottom, faint handwritten text in white ink appears reversed on the image border.
